title: multimon-ng JSON output v2
description: One object per decoded event from multimon-ng --json. Schema version 2 (--json-old produces the pre-v2 legacy format).

$schema.description: Format identifier. Allows line-1 detection without schema_version parsing.

schema_version.description: Integer version gate. Increment on breaking envelope changes.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds (UTC). Always present; not gated on --timestamp.

timestamp_us.description: Microseconds offset within the second. Nonzero only when --iso8601 is active.

demod.description: Exact demodulator token as it appears on the CLI (e.g. POCSAG1200, FLEX_NEXT, GSC). Preserves baud-rate granularity.

protocol.description: Normalized protocol family, lowercase (e.g. pocsag, flex, gsc, eas, fms, selcall, dtmf, morse). Use for routing when baud-rate granularity is not needed.

kind.description: message: carries subscriber payload (capcode + encodings). event: protocol-level signal with no subscriber payload (tone-only, BIW, EOM). diagnostic: decoder internal stats (BCH, etc.). Consumers must tolerate unknown future kinds.

msg_type.description: Protocol-specific message sub-type (e.g. pocsag, alphanumeric, numeric, tone_only, eas_header, bch_stats). Consumers must tolerate unknown values.

capcode.description: Subscriber address (paging capcode). null for events and diagnostics.

message.description: Best-decoded message text shortcut. null for events/diagnostics. For POCSAG this is the highest-scoring heuristic attempt; other protocols emit the single decoded string.

encodings.description: All decode representations of the payload, ordered: raw wire bytes first, then decoded attempts. Empty for events/diagnostics.

encoding.description: Encoding type: raw (hex), alpha, numeric, skyper.

data.description: Decoded content. For raw: lowercase hex string.

score.description: Heuristic quality score. Present for POCSAG auto-mode competing attempts; absent otherwise.

bits.description: Payload bit count. Present for raw entries when the bit count is not a multiple of 8 (e.g. 7-bit packed FLEX alpha).

$comment: additionalProperties:true allows protocol-specific nested objects (e.g. flex:{}, pocsag:{}, gsc:{}) whose key matches the 'protocol' field. Consumers should tolerate unknown protocol keys. New envelope fields will be added with additive-only semver; the integer schema_version is the machine-readable gate.
